title: Ensembling LLMs for AI-Augmented Cybersecurity Software Requirements Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.10316v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Translating high-level controls from security standards into concrete, system-specific requirements is central to cybersecurity requirements engineering. Large language models (LLMs) can accelerate this labor-intensive, recall-sensitive task, but any single run is unreliable: it misses valid safeguards while introducing plausible hallucinations, and outputs shift across runs and models. We reframe this variability as a resource: rather than selecting one output, we study post-generation ensembling, aggregating stochastic runs with information-retrieval data-fusion operators. We propose two strategies: Uniform fusion rewards mere cross-run agreement, whereas Naive-Bayes fusion weights each run by its estimated reliability. We evaluate both over 24 runs from 12 configurations across four model families, generated for ten ISO/IEC 27002:2022 controls and expert-judged against a gold standard of 72 valid requirements. translated_title: 集成大语言模型用于AI增强的网络安全软件需求生成
translated_abstract: 将安全标准中的高层控制措施转化为具体的、针对特定系统的需求是网络安全需求工程的核心。大语言模型（LLM）可以加速这一劳动密集型且对召回率敏感的任务，但任何单次运行都不可靠：它既会遗漏有效的安全防护措施，又会引入看似合理的幻觉内容，且输出在不同运行和不同模型之间会发生变化。我们将这种变异性重新视为一种资源：与其选择单一输出，我们研究生成后集成方法，使用信息检索数据融合算子来聚合随机运行的结果。我们提出两种策略：Uniform融合奖励单纯的跨运行一致性，而朴素贝叶斯融合则根据每次运行的估计可靠性对其进行加权。我们在来自四个模型家族的12种配置所生成的24次运行上进行评估，这些输出针对十个ISO/IEC 27002:2022控制措施生成，并由专家对照包含72个有效需求的黄金标准进行评判。聚合所有运行的输出……
tldr: 该论文提出利用信息检索数据融合算子对大语言模型的多次随机运行结果进行生成后集成（包括奖励跨运行一致性的Uniform融合和按可靠性加权的朴素贝叶斯融合两种策略），将LLM输出的不稳定性转化为资源，从而更可靠地生成网络安全软件需求。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes post-generation ensembling of multiple stochastic LLM runs using information-retrieval data-fusion operators—Uniform fusion rewarding cross-run agreement and Naive-Bayes fusion weighting runs by estimated reliability—turning output variability into a resource for more reliable cybersecurity software requirements generation.
